title: Samsung 14" Galaxy Book6 Laptop (Core Ultra 5 325, 16GB, 512GB, Gray)
amazon_match_notes: Verified exact match: ASIN B0GNCF2QHX is the New Samsung Galaxy Book6 14-inch, MPN NP740VJG-KA2US, UPC 198957323478; Core Ultra 5 325, 16GB/512GB, Gray.

comparisons.notes: NP740VJG-KA1US: Galaxy Book6 14-inch, Core Ultra 5 325, 16GB LPDDR5X, 512GB SSD, Gray, Windows 11 Home. Page says In Stock, ships in 24-48 hours. Same specs as the Woot and Amazon NP740VJG-KA2US.

writeup: Samsung's 14-inch Galaxy Book6 (MPN NP740VJG-KA2US, UPC 198957323478) is a new gray model with an Intel Core Ultra 5 325, 16GB of memory and a 512GB SSD. Woot has it for $749.99. Samsung's own store lists this same configuration at $1,249.99, and Connection has the retail sibling NP740VJG-KA1US in stock at $1,367.61, so you save about $500. Woot is showing only 1 left.
